Meridian Community College’s inaugural Eagles for Life raises $30K for cancer support

By Triston P. Coats
Published: Oct. 20, 2026 at 2:54 PM EDT|Updated: 10 hours ago
Add Us On GoogleAdd as a preferred source on Google
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:47
Instaread

MERIDIAN, Miss. (WTOK) -Meridian Community College is celebrating the success of its inaugural Eagles for Life event.

Nearly 300 attendees gathered Sept. 26 for an evening of hope and generosity, raising $30,000 to support those affected by cancer.

Organizers say the proceeds will establish an endowed scholarship for students facing cancer themselves or who have a parent/guardian who has faced cancer. $5,000 will also go to support the local cancer center.

Officials say because the scholarship is endowed, even more of next year’s proceeds can go directly to the cancer center.

The college says it plans to grow Eagles for Life into an annual community tradition, with next year’s date to be announced well in advance.
